overview: In My Special Tatay, we will see the story of Boyet, a young man with a mild intellectual disability. His quiet and simple life with his single mom Isay will be disrupted when they find out that Boyet has a baby. Despite their status in life and Boyet's condition, they will take care of the child to the best of their ability. They will also be helped by his aunt Chona and his childhood friend / crush Carol. Will they be able to meet the baby's needs? What kind of trials will their little family face? Will Boyet be able to fulfill his responsibility as a father despite his disability? Stay tuned for all that in My Special Tatay.
title: My Special Tatay

overview: Sam is a friendly communications student who likes to party. Clyden is a snobby med student focused on studying. One day, these opposites suddenly find themselves arranged to be married. Will they escape their engagement or will this forced arrangement turn into real love?
title: Avenues of the Diamond

overview: Set against the backdrop of the 1990s, this retro office comedy follows Hong Geum Bo, a no-nonsense financial regulator in her 30s who lives for her work. But when suspicious activity surfaces at a major securities firm, her career takes an unexpected turn. Tasked with uncovering the truth, Geum Bo goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate, diving headfirst into an unfamiliar world of office politics, outdated tech, and hilarious culture clashes.
title: Undercover Miss Hong

overview: Lost in Space is a remake of sci-fi master Irwin Allen's 1965 cult TV classic and is an epic but grounded science fiction saga focusing on an explorer family from Earth lost in an alien universe and the challenges they face in staying together against seemingly insurmountable odds.
title: Lost in Space

overview: Asawa Ng Asawa Ko tells the story of Cristy, Jordan and their daughter Tori. They're the epitome of a happy family, but things changed when Cristy was kidnapped by the armed group KALASAG. For four years, Cristy was held captive by KALASAG. Thinking that Cristy has died already, Jordan marries their friend Shaira, and she becomes the mother figure for Tori. To everyone's shock, Cristy resurfaces and tries to reclaim her old life. Will she fight for the love of her life after all that she'd been through? Can she prove that love is worth fighting for now that her daughter has wholeheartedly accepted her stepmom? Can she get Jordan back from the arms of Shaira?
title: Asawa Ng Asawa Ko

overview: Hello, rockers! Alexander Pushnoy is with you! And today I have prepared a new format for you! NAUCHROK is a new show at the intersection of science and music. My guests and I dissect music and find out how much science there is in it. And of course, we test our theories with the help of Furry experiments! Yes, your favorite uhhh experiments! My friend, colleague, presenter of the Neskuchny Sound channel and songwriter Alexander Zilkov helps us with them. During our conversation, there are viewers in the audience who can ask us any questions. To do this, they only need to scan the QR code and write to our bot.
title: НАУЧРОК

overview: This is our new format where we unpack boxes of legendary players' jerseys and discuss their careers. Everyone brings a jersey of some famous player that they would like to give to the others and puts it in a box. Then we blindly select one of the boxes and take the jersey we got. And of course, we are discussing the career of this player.
title: МИСТЕРИ ДЖЕРСИ

overview: "Stand-up therapy" is a new show in which comedians speak out on really difficult topics that concern them, expanding the boundaries of the funny. Here, audience laughter is therapy for the comedian, which helps them and the audience work through the traumatic moments of their lives. How to survive a painful breakup or even the death of loved ones, what addiction is and how to cope with it, how to live with a serious illness and prolonged depression is about this and not only our show.
title: СТЕНДАП-ТЕРАПИЯ

overview: We have created a computer game for Anton Shastun, in which the main character is Anton Shastun. 4 guests will play a platformer that we have developed especially for them, and at the end of the 4th edition we will find out the best gamer of the tournament!
title: Го, я создал!

overview: Crowdwork is an improvisational show where four comedians compete to see which half of the audience is funnier and more active. The fate of the battle is decided by judges chosen directly from the audience. Whose half of the room turns out to be funnier, takes the stand on the bar.
title: CROWDWORK

overview: Premier League Goal Zone shows the best moments from the weekend in Premier League action.
title: Premier League Goal Zone

overview: The Lost Recipe is a fantasy romance series that revolves around love, time travel, and the culinary world. The series features Adobo, the most renowned Filipino dish in the world, together with other popular Filipino foods.
title: The Lost Recipe

overview: Two Greek-Australian women - beautiful model Vicky and overweight Stella - switch identities during a flight to Greece. Vicky is meeting her fiancé's family, while Stella is meeting an online date.
title: Είσαι το Ταίρι Μου

overview: The story of each crime is woven together through raw, unfiltered video from the point of view of officer body cam and surveillance footage for a first-hand look at justice in action.
title: Crime in Progress

overview: A drama that portrays the story of a family that is a little selfish and perhaps more ordinary than their own, who cherished each other's lives as they grew to love each other.
title: Love Me

overview: They don't make ads like they used to! They may only last a few seconds, but television adverts offer a unique and entertaining window into Irish life over the decades. FADÓ FADÓ, takes us on a nostalgic trip down memory lane as different generations of family and friends come together to revisit the funniest, cheekiest, most unforgettable ads to ever grace Irish screens since television first arrived in homes in the 1960s. From the swinging '60s to the disco-lit '70s, the sky-high hair of the '80s, and the Celtic Tiger–charged, grunge-tinged '90s, we look back at the ads that defined their eras. We discover how they still have the power to shock and delight, to make us laugh and cry—and how they reveal so much about Ireland and how we've evolved.
title: Fadó Fadó

overview: Rebecca Clarke travels from her home city of Chicago to the Western Canadian frontier with her 11-year-old-daughter. But when her wagon breaks down, she has no choice but to accept help from local rancher and confirmed bachelor, Tom Moore. Despite Rebecca's best intentions to remain unattached, the future she dreams of for her and her daughter along with the people she meets in this fledgling town – including the guarded Tom and tenacious pioneer woman Hattie Quinn – ultimately compel her to put down roots and make a fresh start.
title: Hope Valley: 1874
Contrato de corazones, tú y yo

overview: Unforgettable follows Carrie Wells, an enigmatic former police detective with a rare condition that makes her memory so flawless that every place, every conversation, every moment of joy and every heartbreak is forever embedded in her mind. It's not just that she doesn't forget anything - she can't; except for one thing: the details that would help solve her sister's long-ago murder. Carrie has tried to put her past behind her, but she's unexpectedly reunited with her ex-boyfriend and partner, NYPD Detective Al Burns when she consults on a homicide case.
title: Unforgettable

overview: Fitting in is hard enough, but when your dad is Count Dracula, things go from hard to worse! Follow the comic misadventures of Vlad and Ingrid as they move from Transylvania to Britain with their narcissistic single dad, the Count.
title: Young Dracula

overview: Championship Drive is the companion show to "Championship Drive Who's In?" that alternates airings on ESPN, ESPN2 & ESPNEWS. This show goes more in depth into the NCAA College Football playoff possibilities.
title: Championship Drive

overview: Love transcends all ages. And Cupid's arrows choose their targets. Is true love possible between people with an age difference of decades? And what are the prospects for relationships whose participants resemble parents and children more than lovers? How do loved ones perceive their relatives' unusual choices? And what drives those who prefer older people more often – true feelings or self-interest? The film tells the stories of celebrity and ordinary couples: Ivan Krasko and Natalia Shevel, Renat Ibragimov and Svetlana Minnekhanova, Prokhor Shalyapin and Larisa Kopenkina, Alena Kravets and Ruslan.
title: Возраст любви

overview: When people gather in one place and do something. It means only one thing! Karim24 is heading there and will do something that prevents people from doing something.

overview: Gambling show with Dorokhov: three players try to guess the winners of crazy competitions for the grand prize.
title: Азарт

overview: A party show in which participants try to figure out who is the best from the world of sports in a certain "theme" in the format of a simple board game. During the game, participants will argue, convince each other and recall personal stories related to sports.

overview: Welcome to Action Poker: THE WORLD. THE DOOR. THE BALL. A show where players receive secret tasks on their phones that need to be completed unnoticed! To win, you have to lie, bluff, and confuse your opponents.

overview: A nostalgic project about the sporting events of the past. Heroes, matches, victories and tragedies.

Flying axes, shovels, watermelons that fall on cars from a great height and even explosions. Anything can kill a car in this show. Conflicts and showdowns between those who are willing to do a lot for the sake of a car. Will everyone stay in the project at least on the first day? You'll find out in the issue!
title: Уезжай, если сможешь

overview: Fart is the first series in which there are real competitions. 50 beautiful and sexy girls gathered in an underground bunker to win a whole bag of money thanks solely to their luck. Once a week, after completing all the challenges, the winner will leave the bunker, and the rest of the girls will continue to fight for money and their freedom until they are lucky.
title: ФАРТ

overview: "Fists" is a two-part film that tells about fistfights in Russia through the main characters of the industry and their iconic confrontations.
title: Кулаки

overview: The Draw is a new travel show for the cities of the Russian Premier League!
title: Жеребьёвка

overview: "Pressukha" is a new show in which sports stars answer the most audacious questions from toxic and arrogant journalists.
title: ПРЕССУХА

overview: An unusual enemy threatens the stability of the Castillo family. Max, a young man with a power never before seen in the series, uses an enchanted doll to wreak havoc throughout the city, while the protagonists face personal and family challenges that will test their unity and their bond as a group.
title: Los Protegidos: Un nuevo poder

overview: A long series of year chronicles about what happened in Sweden and the world.
title: Året Var…….

overview: Jimmy, a carefree playboy, volunteers to walk Teh home in hopes of getting closer to his crush, Plaifah. Instead, he unexpectedly meets Teh's gentle and enigmatic older brother, Toh. For the first time in his life, Jimmy's heart sounds the alarm for a man he never planned to fall for.
title: Love Alert

overview: Thirteen years after her family was torn apart in childhood, Li Fuyuan returns to Huachang County to avenge her wrongfully killed brother. There, she meets Lu Yanchong, the seemingly frivolous and useless county magistrate. As Lu Yanchong's true identity and motives gradually come to light, the two move from mutual suspicion to working side by side to solve a series of baffling cases, ultimately uncovering the truth behind the "Thrush Case" from thirteen years ago.
title: To Kill a Songbird

overview: Home & Family is a weekday morning 2 hour long talk show hosted by Mark Steines and Cristina Ferrare that offers viewers advice in the areas of home improvement, parenting, health and fitness. The show originates from a New England Colonial-style, fully functioning home built on the Universal Studios lot, with each room of the house being used to show everything from how to buy a week's worth of groceries for $100 to growing organic fruits and vegetables. Steines and Ferrare participate in round-table discussions with experts from various fields, with celebrities occasionally participating as well, in order to get answers for viewers.
title: Home & Family

overview: From 0-26 to two-time Super Bowl champions-this is the unfiltered story of the Buccaneers, told by the legends who lived it: Brady, Gruden, Dungy, Sapp, Brooks, Lynch, Alstott, Evans, Mayfield, and more.
title: Raise the Flags: 50 Years of Buccaneers Football

overview: Sally Lindsay tests two teams of celebrities, led by captains John Thomson and Shappi Khorsandi.
title: Sally Lindsay's Quiz Night

overview: Lord Sugar sends 12 celebrities to Lapland to make and sell festive biscuits for Children in Need. But who will end up on his ‘naughty list'?
title: The Celebrity Apprentice

overview: Eun-jo is the true identity behind Gil-dong, the legendary righteous bandit who robs corrupt officials and redistributes their wealth to the people. Born as the illegitimate daughter of Minister Hong and raised in the lowest social class, Eun-jo lives in a Joseon society where no one would ever suspect a woman of being a notorious outlaw. Behind this prejudice, she carefully maintains a flawless double life. Meanwhile, Yi Yeol—the prince assigned to capture Gil-dong—falls in love with Eun-jo at first sight and begins to pursue her, completely unaware that the woman he loves is the very thief he is hunting. This is a sweeping and dangerous romance: a woman who unintentionally becomes Joseon's greatest thief and a prince bound by duty find their fates intertwined. When their souls are mysteriously exchanged, they embark on a journey to save each other—and ultimately, to protect the people.
title: To My Beloved Thief

overview: Drama moving between the lives, loves and lies of two generations of the same family who live at 32 Brinkburn Street in 1931 and 2011.
title: 32 Brinkburn Street

overview: Babawiin Ko Ang Lahat tells the story of a young woman, Iris, whose perfect life is upended with the return of her father's original family.
title: Babawiin Ko ang Lahat

overview: Nolie is a poor province girl who works in a grape farm hacienda. Due to her naivete, she falls in love with Anselmo, the son of Martina who has a strong hatred of Nolie's family. Things get complicated when Nolie gets pregnant and Ansel leaves her and reveals that she has a girlfriend. Years later, still raw from the heartache and pain, Nolie decides to get revenge on Ansel's family even at the expense of keeping her daughter's real identity.
title: Bilangin ang Bituin sa Langit

overview: Kara and Mia have two faces divided into one body, Kara in the front and Mia in the back. When they grow up, they will discover a way to separate their face from their own body each morning, while returning to their original shape at night.
title: Kara Mia

overview: Babae...Ngayon at Kailanman is a film adaptation of three Filipino short story masterpieces: Nick Joaquin's "May Day Eve", Amador Daguio's "Wedding Dance" and Wilfrido Nollega's "Juego de Prenda.
title: Ngayon at Kailanman

overview: Joseph, a vendor in Divisoria uses his charm and enthusiasm to get through the hard days. Together with his adoptive family Strawberry and Char, he continues to find happiness despite the challenges in life. One day, he gets in a near-death accident leading him to lose his eyesight and gain the ability of clairvoyance.
title: The Gift

overview: Bringing shadowy aspects of a wide range of topics to light revealing the details hidden when underexposed.
title: Under Exposure

overview: A Welsh fishing village finds itself at the centre of a massive drug smuggling ring.
title: Cannabis Cove: Operation Seal Bay

overview: Nick Roest, a former K1-champion, who is released from prison after four years for a misdemeanour. Nick wants to pick his life again by rising back to the top in fighting game, by training in his fathers sport school.
title: Vechtershart

overview: "SAMIZDAT" is a new conversational and interactive show in which Maxim Zayats, Sergey Shevelev, Sergey Gorokh and Artyom Gaus communicate with the audience and turn their life stories into literary works right on stage. Each guest can become a co-author of a future book!
title: САМЫЗДАТ

overview: Avril and Jade, twin sisters, have nothing in common except their faces. Avril craves the spotlight, the attention, the followers. Jade, on the other hand, prefers the shadows. But when Avril, an aspiring influencer about to release her first single, disappears, her sister Jade decides to take her place and her dream. She is suddenly thrust into a rapid and unexpected rise to fame, at the heart of a music industry as fascinating as it is demanding. Becoming a star in just a few months, she confronts the shadows her sister left behind, and truths that could shatter everything.
title: Les Jolies Choses

overview: Jamie Durie enlists top builders and innovators to construct the ultimate affordable Future House: eco-friendly, stunning designs, and built fast.
title: Jamie Durie's Future House

overview: In the village of Aravangad, Sub-Inspector Vishnu is forced to shift his police station to a haunted Forest Inspection Bungalow with a dark past.
title: Inspection Bungalow

overview: Kelsey Grammar dives into eight key battles to reveal their military tactics, the motivations of the soldiers who fought, the decisions that led to battle, and the long-term consequences.
title: Kelsey Grammer's Historic Battles for America

overview: "The Yard" is a show where 1,000,000,000 rubles are up for grabs. However, in this show, everything costs money. Ten celebrities will have to survive, betray, and test their greed. And only one will take what they can save.
title: Ярд

overview: The Rapture is a high-stakes thriller which crackles with danger. Set in a heatwave, with protestors on the streets, forensic psychologist Gabs Fox starts a new job at a high-security psychiatric hospital where she meets 17-year-old Bethany Krall. Bethany was convicted of murdering her mother but claims she is innocent. She is estranged from her father Leonard, who is the charismatic leader of an influential religious movement. Bethany tells Gabs that she has psychic powers and can predict the future - but what will it take for Gabs to believe her? And if Bethany didn't kill her mother, then who did?
title: The Rapture

overview: "Highston" Liggetts is a kind and curious 19-year-old struggling to find his place in a world he doesn't quite understand. To help him cope, Highston imagines a constantly changing roster of celebrity friends who provide him with comfort and advice - much to the concern of his bewildered but empathetic extended family.
title: Highston

overview: Home Reimagined travels across the country to mentor brave renovators who have taken on the task of converting unusual commercial and industrial spaces into one-of-a-kind family homes.
title: Home Reimagined

overview: A romantic comedy exploring the lives of two individuals at different crossroads in life. Reporter Lee Jae has transitioned from a fearless teen driven by dreams to a disillusioned 20-something facing the harsh realities of life, and finally becoming an adult in her 30s who feels like she has settled into mediocrity. On the other hand, film director Su Bin has lived a life designed by his parents during his teenage years but eventually broke free and charged through his 20s and ultimately achieved the dream he had longed for by his 30s.
title: Dream to You

overview: Filmed during BC's worst fire season on record, this series parachutes you onto the frontlines of recent wildfires. With unprecedented access, it follows the brave firefighters dedicated to protecting communities and shares the latest understanding about wildfire prevention.
title: Wildfire

overview: Rififi is inspired by the notorious bank robbery that took place in Athens in 1992. Who carried it out and why? The authorities spoke of organized crime, terrorist groups, and highly educated, ruthless perpetrators. But was it really like that? Through the power of fiction, the new production by COSMOTE TV combines the biggest heist ever committed in Greece with a true story of human tragedy, creating a character-driven series full of emotion and strong elements of humor.
title: Ριφιφί

overview: Set in the tumultuous 1880s American frontier, The Magnificent Seven is a reimagining of the classic Western tale. After a peaceful Quaker village is massacred by mercenaries working for a greedy and ruthless land baron trying to force them off the land he covets, seven gifted but flawed mercenaries are hired by the community to protect them from the land baron's hired guns. But as the team embeds itself in the community, preparing to defend them against overwhelming odds, they are all forced to grapple with an essential question: is the use of violence acceptable to defend a people whose faith is based on non-violence? The series takes a deep dive into the stories behind each of the Seven; what's at stake for them, and why they choose to take on this mission. Like the original, this updated take on the classic story explores themes of honor, sacrifice and redemption, focusing on morality, faith, and the cost of courage.
title: The Magnificent Seven

overview: Young inmate Adèle lands a day job at a luxurious Paris hotel as part of an early-release deal, willing to endure any humiliation for a fresh start. But when she discovers her criminal past and her disposability are the very reason the Palace hired her, a dangerous game of power and manipulation begins.
title: Privilèges

overview: Besties Amanda Holden and Alan Carr take on a big fat Greek renovation on the idyllic Ionian island of Corfu. It's tearing down walls by day and smashing plates by night.
title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job

overview: This docu-series follows a Texas family who abandons their comfort zone for the Croatian seas, they discover that the most profound adventures and deepest connections happen when you're brave enough to navigate the unknown together.
title: Adventure in Wonder

overview: In 2010, the Yorkshire village of Melsonby was left in disbelief when postmistress Diana Garbutt was found murdered in the post office she ran with her husband, Robin. Robin claimed she'd been the victim of a violent intruder, but as detectives probed further, suspicion began to fall on him. Prosecutors claimed that behind the façade of a happy marriage lay deep marital and financial turmoil and £16,000 missing from the safe. They argued that when Diana confronted Robin over the missing money, he killed her. In 2011, Robin Garbutt was sentenced to life in prison. Robin has always maintained his innocence and over the last 14 years has unsuccessfully appealed his conviction three times. But with one of the central planks of the prosecution coming from the Horizon system — the technology now at the centre of the Post Office scandal — Robin and his legal team are once again attempting to clear his name. Murder at the Post Office meticulously re-examines the case, featuring voices on both sides: those convinced Robin was wrongfully convicted and others who are unsure and still suspect he is guilty.
title: Murder at the Post Office

overview: Ireland with Simon Reeve explores the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland in a new two-part series for BBC Two. Both form one of the most beautiful islands in the world: a place steeped in history, culture and belief, but one with a complex and troubled past.
title: Ireland with Simon Reeve

overview: Amanda Holden and Alan Carr will be moving countries for their biggest project yet – they're heading to the sunny south of Spain where they'll take on a rambling, run down property in the province of Andalusia for the third series of their hugely popular series where they renovate ageing properties. With many rural areas suffering from de-population, they're hoping to remedy this and bring the tourists back by highlighting some unloved and forgotten areas around the Costa del Sol, in Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job.
title: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job

overview: See in the new year with a rollercoaster of feel-good hits, incredible performances and big surprises. Join pop icon Ronan Keating for an unforgettable party!
title: Ronan Keating and Friends: A New Year's Eve Party

overview: Under the watchful eye of Sergei Burunov, the star-studded cast uncovers the intrigues of an Indian palace to secure 10 million rubles.
title: Тайный миллионер

overview: Frank's and Lisa's love and family life is put to the test when he downloads the AI app 'Maia' who turns out to be his able and willing dream partner. Alarmed, Lisa asks him, what's so bad about our real life? And he searches for answers.
title: The other gAIrl

overview: Horizons will explore a single science, health, technology or environmental topic each week.
title: Horizons from PBS News

overview: Compass Points will address one international topic per episode, featuring analysis from a panel of experts that may include journalists and former government officials.
title: Compass Points from PBS News

overview: An all-access series gives viewers a glimpse into each of the top four teams' preparation leading up to and through the semifinals and national championship.
title: Inside the College Football Playoff

overview: Out of Bounds explores the latest stories and biggest scandals shaking up the sports world.
title: Out of Bounds

overview: From last-second heroics to gut-wrenching collapses, the most legendary comebacks in sports.
title: Don't Call It a Comeback

overview: In this three-part series narrated by Dara Ó Briain, we'll take to the skies over six of Ireland's national parks to witness the wonder of this land from above, before swooping down to the ground to meet the people living and working in these spectacular locations.
title: National Parks from Above: Ireland with Dara O Briain
